about.name: Harsh Walia
about.title: MSc Investments
bio: I am studying for an MSc in Investments at the University of Birmingham. I write research on listed companies and build the valuation models behind it, and I publish both here so anyone can check the working.

My coverage is transport, travel and logistics. The same drivers keep coming back in those sectors: capacity, load factor, pricing, fuel and labour. What I learn on one company carries over to the next.
The models are built in Excel and Python. Every forecast driver traces back to a published source, and where a number is not verified at source, the note says so.

I also read the people who do this for a living. I follow bankers and equity analysts on LinkedIn and have connected with a number of them. Comparing how they frame a company with how I framed it is the quickest way I have found to spot what I missed.
